R. Q. 1 ضَمْضَمَ عَلَى المَالِ He took all the property; (K;) as though he drew it, or gathered it, (ضَمَّهُ,) to himself. (TA.) [See also 5.] ―
-b2- And ضَمْضَمَ He (a man, TA) encouraged his heat; or became courageous in heart. (K, accord. to different copies.) ―
-b3- And, said of a lion, He [roared, or] uttered a cry: (K, TA:) inf. n. ضَمْضَمَةٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
